trimmingSuggestions.description: Remove Repeated Phrases: Each scene features the phrase 'What is...' followed by the abbreviation. Consider shortening these to make the transitions snappier. For example, instead of 'Okay, then what is I.C.V.N.?' it could simply be 'I.C.V.N.?'.
Condense the Answers: The full forms of the codes are repeated twice in each scene. Condensing this to a single mention would make the video more concise.
